exam.title: SnowPro Core
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite is published. Snowflake recommends six or more months using Snowflake. Build SQL/cloud fundamentals, then practice architecture and object context, least-privilege account/warehouse operation, governed loading/unloading/transformation across data forms, evidence-led performance work, collaboration/protection, and secure diagnosable connectivity in a disposable account.

findings.title: Public scope and missing lifecycle baseline are different review boundaries
findings.evidence: Seven abilities unchanged;no direct detailed PDF link;only lifecycle baseline missing.
findings.recommendation: Preserve objective bytes,initialize lifecycle explicitly and retain form-limited scope.
findings.resolution: Preserve objective bytes,initialize lifecycle explicitly and retain form-limited scope.

findings.title: A training outline is supporting evidence rather than detailed exam weights
findings.evidence: Actual4page25L19PDF contains five areas and nineteen teaching bullets with preparation-dependent duration.
findings.recommendation: Map those as supporting prompts across seven abilities without asserting weights or exam duration.
findings.resolution: Map those as supporting prompts across seven abilities without asserting weights or exam duration.

findings.title: Authentication enforcement is rolling and account-specific
findings.evidence: Phase3August-October2026,account notification and excluded account types.
findings.recommendation: Date the guidance and require actual account/user/client verification rather than universal enforcement claims.
findings.resolution: Date the guidance and require actual account/user/client verification rather than universal enforcement claims.

findings.title: Legacy notebook creation guidance needs a current boundary
findings.recommendation: Use current Workspaces migration route and distinguish planned changes from already effective ones.
findings.resolution: Use current Workspaces migration route and distinguish planned changes from already effective ones.

findings.title: MERGE does not automatically deduplicate unmatched inserts
findings.evidence: Default ambiguous-match errors apply to matching updates/deletes;duplicate unmatched source rows can each insert.
findings.recommendation: Teach grain and tie policy before MERGE;executed local join workbook demonstrates analytical corruption separately.
findings.resolution: Teach grain and tie policy before MERGE;executed local join workbook demonstrates analytical corruption separately.

findings.title: Filtering consumed changes does not reserve omitted rows
findings.evidence: Committed consuming DML advances stream position across all changes;SELECT and rollback do not.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit offset/replay explanation and proposed positive/rollback/filter lab.
findings.resolution: Add explicit offset/replay explanation and proposed positive/rollback/filter lab.

findings.title: Freshness target is not an exact interval or guarantee
findings.evidence: Best-effort root-relative target,minimum60s,terminalDOWNSTREAM no automatic consumer.
findings.recommendation: Teach actual freshness monitoring and scheduled terminal consumer design.
findings.resolution: Teach actual freshness monitoring and scheduled terminal consumer design.

findings.title: Implicit window expectations can produce wrong running totals
findings.evidence: ROWS and RANGE peers differ;window ORDERBY separate from output ORDERBY.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit frames/tie-breaker and actual SQLite peer/row comparison.
findings.resolution: Add explicit frames/tie-breaker and actual SQLite peer/row comparison.

findings.title: A repeated fast query need not measure warehouse execution
findings.evidence: Result reuse has strict conditions and no guarantee;24h/31day retention;USE_CACHED_RESULT not all caches.

findings.title: Warehouse load is concurrency rather than CPU percent
findings.evidence: Load is running/queued query time divided by observation interval;overload/provisioning/locks separate.
findings.recommendation: Add synthetic clipped-interval arithmetic and evidence-led scale decisions.
findings.resolution: Add synthetic clipped-interval arithmetic and evidence-led scale decisions.

findings.title: Missing paths and parse failures can collapse to SQL NULL
findings.evidence: Missing path SQLNULL differs from JSONnull,while TRY_PARSE_JSON can return SQLNULL on malformed input.
findings.recommendation: Correct earlier missing-key wording and preserve parse status/raw input.
findings.resolution: Correct earlier missing-key wording and preserve parse status/raw input.

findings.title: Standard primary keys do not enforce business uniqueness
findings.recommendation: Teach business-key validation and explicitly label SQLite key enforcement.
findings.resolution: Teach business-key validation and explicitly label SQLite key enforcement.
